comparison: Strong agreement on study limitations (C123-C127). Both acknowledge the absence of DNA-bound structures and incomplete HROB visualization. OpenEval rates as SUPPORTED for honest acknowledgment of limitations, while peer reviewers emphasize these as critical gaps requiring additional studies.

Strong agreement on in vivo validation (C88-C91). Both recognize the cell viability assays and complementation experiments as strong support. OpenEval and peer reviewers (Reviewer 1) both rate these claims as SUPPORTED, noting that mutations impaired MCM8-9 activity in vivo.

Partial disagreement on structural claims (C2, C31-C36, C92). OpenEval rates as SUPPORTED based on cryo-EM data quality. Peer reviewers rate as UNCERTAIN, with Reviewer 1 noting that 'most structural data are shown only as ribbon model without showing the density map data' and Reviewer 3 emphasizing the structure is 'not a DNA-bound form,' limiting mechanistic conclusions.

Agreement on ACL analysis (C69-C71, C75-C76). Both rate as SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes the negative mutagenesis result is reasonable though could reflect redundancy. Peer reviewers (Reviewer 1) acknowledge the identification of important residues with functional validation.

Disagreement on HROB-induced conformational changes (C54-C63). OpenEval rates as SUPPORTED based on combined structural and biochemical data. Peer reviewers rate as UNCERTAIN, with Reviewer 3 emphasizing that 'HROB was not visible in the structural data' and direct visualization of MCM8/9-HROB complex is essential.

Agreement on OB-hp functional importance (C64-C65, C67, C73-C74, C77, C103). OpenEval rates as SUPPORTED with caveat about DNA docking model. Peer reviewers (Reviewer 1) rate as SUPPORTED, noting identification of important residues with functional validation through helicase assays.

Agreement on N-C linker and CTD flexibility (C82, C84-C86, C120). Both rate as SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes reasonable inference connecting structural features to dynamics. Peer reviewers acknowledge flexible CTD nature and functional validation through mutational analysis in vitro and in vivo.

Agreement on CTD rotary motion (C5, C80-C81, C119). Both rate as SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes multi-body refinement supports flexibility but functional interpretation is inferred. Peer reviewers (Reviewer 3) acknowledge 'flexible nature of MCM8/9-CTD' as a strength with functional validation.

Agreement on DNA entry gate hypothesis (C42-C43, C46). OpenEval rates as SUPPORTED noting the inference is reasonable but requires experimental validation. Peer reviewers rate as SUPPORTED, acknowledging the structural basis for the gate proposal though direct functional evidence is lacking.

Agreement on loading state interpretation (C51, C53). Both rate as UNCERTAIN. OpenEval notes this is a working hypothesis based on structural similarity. Peer reviewers note data support the conclusion but emphasize it's interpretive, with Reviewer 3 highlighting the structure is 'not a DNA-bound form.'

Agreement on helicase assay data (C72-C74). OpenEval rates as SUPPORTED based on direct experimental evidence. Peer reviewers also support these claims as part of the biochemical validation that strengthens structural inferences.

Disagreement on HROB mechanism (C110, C113, C122). OpenEval rates as SUPPORTED with caveat that DNA loading mechanism is inferred. Peer reviewers rate as UNCERTAIN, emphasizing the critical limitation that HROB is not visible in structural data, making mechanistic interpretation less certain.

Partial overlap on major findings summary (C92-C95). OpenEval rates summary claims as SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers express concerns about the structural data presentation and absence of DNA-bound form, which tempers confidence in some summarized conclusions.
